additional_isolated_probes.name: zero_row_lock_release_after_job_update
additional_isolated_probes.injection: Temporary system_config BEFORE UPDATE trigger RAISE(IGNORE) for Inventory release only

findings.description_zh: 原job终态更新后锁UPDATE零行，事务仍提交；commit后返回False不能撤销成功事实。
findings.description_en: A zero-row lock update still commits the preceding job terminal update. Returning False after commit cannot roll it back.
findings.fix_zh: 在原事务内部要求锁更新rowcount精确1，否则raise并回滚；新增零行负例。
findings.fix_en: Require exactly one changed lock row inside the transaction, otherwise raise and roll back; add the zero-row negative case.

limitations_zh: 仅临时SQLite/HTTP/Windows子进程隔离测试，业务worker、签名、SAFE数量为替身。
trigger为隔离故障注入，未声称现场存在该trigger。
formalbackend及所有生产门禁false，非可安装验收。
limitations_en: Only isolated SQLite/HTTP/Windows child tests; business workers, signatures and SAFE counts remain doubles.
The trigger is an isolated failure injection, not a claim about site schema.
Formal backend and production gates remain false; no installation approval.
